title: What happened in AI — Oct 28, 2026
intro: The agent harness is turning into a shippable product: Microsoft opened the Copilot harness through Foundry and Cursor released its Agent SDK, while LangChain pushed scheduled and memory-backed agents.
The best evidence today is measurement: 270 guardrail runs and 324 agent sprints put numbers on what actually keeps coding agents reliable.
highlights: Microsoft makes the multi-model Copilot harness available through Foundry.
Cursor ships the Agent SDK for event-driven agents defined as code.
270 coding-agent runs test whether guardrails pay off.
324 agent sprints: 79% of committed stories done in-sprint, merge as slow as build.
Google open-sources Agent Mesh for verifiable agent identity.

categories.name: Agent harnesses and runtimes are becoming products
categories.summary: Vendors are shipping the harness itself as a reusable layer: multi-model, event-driven, scheduled and memory-backed.

articles.title: Microsoft makes its Copilot agent harness available through Foundry
articles.summary: Microsoft exposes the Copilot harness behind Copilot Code, Copilot Studio and the CLI through Foundry as a multi-model agent layer.

articles.title: The Agent SDK
articles.summary: Cursor releases the Agent SDK it uses internally, for agents defined as code that act on events such as PR reviews or incidents.

articles.title: How to Build Proactive, Always-On Agents with the Schedules SDK in Managed Deep Agents
articles.summary: LangChain's Schedules SDK for Managed Deep Agents frames proactive agents as cron-triggered runs.

articles.title: How to build evidence-grounded agent memory with OpenWiki and Graphs
articles.summary: LangChain shows an evidence-grounded memory layer built on OpenWiki and graphs, so agents stop rebuilding context per question.

categories.name: Measured results on coding-agent guardrails and process
categories.summary: Today's strongest posts report run counts and scores, not opinions, on what makes coding agents reliable.

articles.title: Do Guardrails Make AI Coding Agents Better? What 270 Runs Showed
articles.summary: 270 unattended runs across three models and seven tasks test whether instruction files and pre-commit gates pay for themselves.

articles.title: Agent Scrum: Running a team of AI coding agents in two-hour sprints
articles.summary: Across 324 two-hour agent sprints, 79% of committed stories finished in-sprint, and approval-to-merge took as long as the build.

articles.title: Getting an analytics agent from 50% to 96% accuracy
articles.summary: Benchouse took an analytics agent from 50% to 96% accuracy and found that more documentation sometimes made it drop the expected calculation.

articles.title: Artificial Analysis v5 and the benchmarker's dilemma
articles.summary: Interconnects argues independent benchmarks are hard to keep meaningful at the frontier, framed around Artificial Analysis v5.

categories.name: Agent identity and sandbox claims get testable
categories.summary: Two open-source projects target trust boundaries: verifiable agent identity and runnable contracts for sandbox claims.

articles.title: Agentmesh – open-source zero-trust agent network from Google
articles.summary: Google's Agent Mesh gives each agent node a verifiable identity and a way to publish and call tools across a private network, including behind NAT.

articles.title: I ran each AI coding-agent sandbox's own tests against the others
articles.summary: sandbox-conformance turns sandbox claims such as no key reads or no network into runnable contracts with per-sandbox results.

categories.name: Frontier model and serving infrastructure
categories.summary: A new Google frontier model was announced, alongside serving-side moves on freshness and routing.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon as its next frontier model; the announcement text in the feed carries no further detail.

articles.title: Airbnb Cuts Recommendation Staleness from 2 Days to Seconds with Chronon
articles.summary: Airbnb used Chronon to cut recommendation feature staleness from two days to seconds.

articles.title: Requesty: AI Gateway and LLM Router for 600 Models in EU Datacenters
articles.summary: Requesty offers one API over 600+ models with routing, failover, spend limits and per-request observability in EU datacenters.
